title: Empty room to furnished room
technique: first + last frame; the staged room is an edit of the empty one
style: Real-estate photography, wide 16mm lens, eye-level, bright natural daylight, true-to-life colors.

keyframes.prompt: An empty, freshly painted living room with oak floors, a large window on the left and a fireplace on the back wall. 16:9 composition.

The same living room, same walls, window, fireplace and camera position, now furnished in Scandinavian style: a light grey sofa facing the fireplace, a round oak coffee table, a wool rug, two plants and a floor lamp. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: Slow dolly forward into the room while the furniture appears piece by piece: the rug unrolls, the sofa and table settle into place, plants and the lamp fade in. Soft room tone and gentle piano.
